reopening_conditions: Bounded use shows that the doctrine causes per-turn state inventory, defensive preservation, or reset anxiety instead of keeping durability management low-salience.

relationships.rationale: The approved observation proposal supplies bounded pressure, lifecycle, checkpoint, and rehydration evidence for this judgment while explicitly not owning safety, benefit judgment, or replacement authority.

Role-owned state protects consequences whose loss would invalidate continuation; this proposal governs economic treatment of remaining working meaning and requires the mandatory boundary not to expand into continuous preservation of everything costly to reconstruct.
